(rule!
 (let ()
   (define longest #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define obs (objects-8 g bg))
   (define sample (first obs))
   (define sample-cells (obj-cells sample))
   (define direction
     (cond
       ((= (obj-h sample) 1) (list 0 1))
       ((= (obj-w sample) 1) (list 1 0))
       ((= (length (remove-duplicates
                     (map (lambda (p) (- (first p) (second p))) sample-cells))) 1)
        (list 1 1))
       (else (list 1 -1))))
   (define dr (first direction))
   (define dc (second direction))
   (define (projection p) (+ (* dr (first p)) (* dc (second p))))
   (define (perpendicular p) (+ (* (- dc) (first p)) (* dr (second p))))
   (define (min-end obj) (pick-min (obj-cells obj) projection))
   (define (max-end obj) (pick-max (obj-cells obj) projection))
   (define min-ends (map min-end obs))
   (define max-ends (map max-end obs))
   (define min-aligned?
     (= (length (remove-duplicates (map projection min-ends))) 1))
   (define max-aligned?
     (= (length (remove-duplicates (map projection max-ends))) 1))
   (define anchor-min? min-aligned?)
   (define (anchor obj) (if anchor-min? (min-end obj) (max-end obj)))
   (define ordered
     (sort obs (lambda (a b) (< (perpendicular (anchor a))
                                (perpendicular (anchor b))))))
   (define target-length
     (if longest
         (apply max (map obj-size obs))
         (obj-size (list-ref ordered (quotient (length ordered) 2)))))
   (define step-r (if anchor-min? dr (- dr)))
   (define step-c (if anchor-min? dc (- dc)))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w bg))) ((obj ordered))
     (let ((start (anchor obj)))
       (for/fold ((painted out)) ((i (range target-length)))
         (set-cell painted
                   (+ (first start) (* i step-r))
                   (+ (second start) (* i step-c))
                   (obj-color obj)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Parallel monochrome segments share an aligned starting OR ending baseline.
 ;; Sort them across that baseline and read the spatially middle segment's length.
 ;; Normalize every segment to that length from its aligned endpoint, clipping at
 ;; the canvas and preserving colors. The optional policy highlights the segment
 ;; with most actually changed cells, counting added AND erased cells after clipping.
 ;; The admitted grammar has odd segment count, a unique modal background and a
 ;; unique edit winner. Ties in general inputs use perpendicular spatial order.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define output-policy "largest_edit")
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define objects-list (objects-8 g bg))
   (define (ordered o) (sort (obj-cells o) cell<))
   (define example (ordered (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) objects-list))))
   (define dr (- (first (second example)) (first (first example))))
   (define dc (- (second (second example)) (second (first example))))
   (define (along p) (+ (* dr (first p)) (* dc (second p))))
   (define (across o) (- (* dr (second (first (ordered o)))) (* dc (first (first (ordered o))))))
   (define segments (sort objects-list < #:key across))
   (define start-level (along (first (ordered (first segments)))))
   (define from-start? (andmap (lambda (o) (= start-level (along (first (ordered o))))) segments))
   (define rr (if from-start? dr (- dr)))
   (define cc (if from-start? dc (- dc)))
   (define canonical-target (obj-size (list-ref segments (quotient (length segments) 2))))
   (define target
    (cond
     [(equal? output-policy "median_length") (list-ref (sort (map obj-size segments) <) (quotient (length segments) 2))]
     [(equal? output-policy "max_length") (apply max (map obj-size segments))]
     [else canonical-target]))
   (define (anchor o) (if from-start? (first (ordered o)) (last (ordered o))))
   (define (normalized o)
    (let ((p (anchor o)))
     (for/list ((i (range target))
       #:when (in-bounds? (+ (first p) (* i rr)) (+ (second p) (* i cc)) h w))
      (list (+ (first p) (* i rr)) (+ (second p) (* i cc))))))
   (define (score o)
    (let* ((old (obj-size o)) (new (length (normalized o))))
     (cond
      [(equal? output-policy "requested_edit") (abs (- target old))]
      [(equal? output-policy "longest_input") old]
      [(equal? output-policy "shortest_input") (- old)]
      [(equal? output-policy "growth_only") (max 0 (- new old))]
      [(equal? output-policy "shrink_only") (max 0 (- old new))]
      [(equal? output-policy "largest_rendered") new]
      [(equal? output-policy "ignore_singletons") (if (= old 1) -1 (abs (- new old)))]
      [else (abs (- new old))])))
   (define selected (cond [(equal? output-policy "first_line") (first segments)]
                          [(equal? output-policy "last_line") (last segments)]
                          [else (pick-max segments score)]))
   (define normalized-grid
    (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w bg))) ((o segments))
     (recolor-cells out (normalized o) (obj-color o))))
   (if (equal? output-policy "all_lines") normalized-grid
    (recolor-cells normalized-grid (normalized selected) 8)))))

(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
  (define bg (mode g -1)) (define objs (objects-8 g bg))
  (define (same? f cells) (all? (lambda (p) (= (f p) (f (first cells)))) cells))
  (define (dir cells) (cond ((same? first cells) (list 0 1)) ((same? second cells) (list 1 0)) ((same? (lambda (p) (- (first p) (second p))) cells) (list 1 1)) (else (list 1 -1))))
  (define d (dir (obj-cells (first objs)))) (define (anchor o) (first (sort (obj-cells o) cell<)))
  (define (offset o) (let ((a (anchor o))) (cond ((equal? d (list 0 1)) (first a)) ((equal? d (list 1 0)) (second a)) ((equal? d (list 1 1)) (- (first a) (second a))) (else (+ (first a) (second a))))))
  (define (shift delta) (cond ((equal? d (list 0 1)) (list delta 0)) ((equal? d (list 1 0)) (list 0 delta)) ((equal? d (list 1 1)) (list (quotient delta 2) (- (quotient delta 2)))) (else (list (quotient delta 2) (quotient delta 2)))))
  (define ordered (sort objs (lambda (a b) (< (offset a) (offset b))))) (define central (list-ref ordered (quotient (length ordered) 2)))
  (define (target o) (let ((s (shift (- (offset o) (offset central))))) (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) (first s)) (+ (second p) (second s)))) (obj-cells central))))
  (define (adjust o) (+ (count-where (lambda (p) (not (member p (target o)))) (obj-cells o)) (count-where (lambda (p) (not (member p (obj-cells o)))) (target o))))
  (define biggest (apply max (map adjust objs)))
  (define cleared (for/fold ((out g)) ((o (in-list objs))) (paint-cells out (obj-cells o) bg)))
  (for/fold ((out cleared)) ((o (in-list objs))) (paint-cells out (target o) (if (= (adjust o) biggest) 9 (obj-color o))))))
